title: Project-bound task composer UI v1
description: After the Workspace Registry + Project Binding v1 sync is complete, sync ONLY src/components/IdentityBanner.tsx from current GitHub main so the expanded Projects panel can create a task bound to the selected workspace/project and the selected ChatGPT or Studio agent_instance_id. Keep the collapsed top bar one compact line. Do not redesign Mission Control. Do not edit runtime data. Run npm run lint and npm run build, restart Preview, visually verify the Projects panel, and verify that the UI calls POST /api/studio-relay/bound-task with workspace_id, project_id, and agent_instance_id. Do not Publish yet. Report completion through Studio Relay.
